templates.name: Scope Drift Trimmer: Inventory Access Review
templates.description: Runs `sdt analyze` on an Agent Security Suite inventory that another suite tool writes on its own schedule, and writes it back with scope-drift-trimmer findings: dormant privileged identities, unused grants, narrower permissions, and write or admin grants whose use the platform doesn't record. Fails the run when a finding is at or above the chosen severity, so the failure alert is the prompt to review. Every finding carries a draft remediation for a human to review and run; nothing is applied. Usage windows end at the inventory's own generatedAt, so the output file must not be the inventory: sdt stamps its output with the run's time. Reads one file, writes one, makes no network call and holds no credential. Needs Node 22.18 or newer and a clone of scope-drift-trimmer with `npm install` and `npm run build` run in it.

packs.name: Scope Drift Trimmer: Access Review
packs.description: Re-runs the non-human identity access review on the inventory the Agent Security Suite writes, and fails when a finding needs a human.
